name: TagInput
description: A text box that turns entries into chips: Enter or comma adds a tag that pops in while its neighbours slide aside, Backspace arms then removes the last chip, duplicates shake the existing chip, and pasted comma lists are split automatically.
a11yNotes: A native text input labelled by a visible <label> and described by a keyboard hint. Chips are list items in a labelled list (with the tag count); each has a native remove button labelled 'Remove <tag>' that also responds to Backspace/Delete. Backspace in an empty input first highlights the last chip, then removes it; Escape clears the draft. Additions and removals are announced through a polite live region and focus returns to the input after removal. Under prefers-reduced-motion chips fade without scaling or layout sliding.

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the next list whenever a tag is added or removed.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Visible label and accessible name of the text box.

propsApi.name: placeholder
propsApi.description: Placeholder shown in the text box.

propsApi.name: maxTags
propsApi.description: Maximum number of tags; 0 means unlimited. The input disables when the limit is reached.

propsApi.name: allowDuplicates
propsApi.description: Allow the same tag more than once; otherwise the existing chip shakes.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Chip tint and focus ring color.

propsApi.name: disabled
propsApi.description: Disable the field and remove buttons.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
